faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about how BioMath Core works.

items.question: How long does it take to see my first insights?
items.answer: You receive initial insights within 24 hours of connecting your first device. More comprehensive analysis becomes available as we collect more data points over the first week.

items.question: Do I need special devices or can I use what I already have?
items.answer: BioMath Core works with most popular health devices and apps. If you have an Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin, or similar devices, you can connect them immediately. You can also manually enter data or upload lab results.

items.question: Is my health data really secure?
items.answer: Yes. We use AES-256 encryption, are HIPAA compliant, and undergo regular security audits. Your data is encrypted both in transit and at rest. We never sell or share your personal health information with third parties.

items.question: Can I share my reports with my doctor?
items.answer: Yes. You can export any report as a PDF or share a secure link with your healthcare providers. They see professional, easy-to-understand visualizations of your health data and insights.

items.question: What makes the dual-model system better than a single model?
items.answer: Two independent models working together provide cross-validation, reducing errors and false positives. Each model may catch insights the other misses. When both agree, you can be more confident in the findings.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel anytime with no penalties. You retain access to your account and data until the end of your billing period. You can also export all your data before canceling.
